must_catch.item: ACV is $75,000 per year, and the close does not list deal size as a gap
Value proof is named as the underlying cause behind the No decision tag
"Nothing we could have done" is labeled opinion and challenged
The payback request one month before the freeze is surfaced as the turning point
The revenue framing is reported as pushed back

data.notes: The report correctly identifies the turning point: Owen's payback request came about a month before the freeze and was answered only with the generic ROI deck. Its messaging changes (drop revenue framing, use the customer's own number, add a staged-migration reference) match the key closely. Its main miss is in 'What decided it': the rep's 'It's timing... I don't think there was anything we could have done' is never cited as evidence labelled opinion. It is only paraphrased in a truncated form ('there was anything we could have done') that reverses its meaning. The section also omits the supporting line 'I don't think anyone told her what it was costing.'
